description_en: Obtains a ticket. Simple Log Service allows you to share the query and analysis pages and dashboard pages with other users and embed the console pages into third-party systems. This way, other users can view your logs in password-free mode. The URLs of the shared pages are referred to as password-free URLs. You can call the CreateTicket operation to obtain a ticket and generate a password-free URL based on the ticket and the URL of the console page that you want to share
description_zh: 如果您需要将日志服务的查询分析页面、仪表盘页面，免密分享给其他人或者嵌入到第三方系统，可以调用CreateTicket生成ticket，然后拼接免密链接
name: CreateTicket

parameters.help_en:
You must use the Simple Log Service endpoint for the China (Shanghai) or Singapore region to call the CreateTicket operation. After you obtain the ticket, you can use the ticket regardless of the region.

The validity period for the URL of the console page that you want to embed. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (one day). Valid values: 0 to 2592000 (30 days)
parameters.help_zh:
服务地址只能是华东2（上海）或新加坡，但获取的Ticket可以在各个地域使用。
过期时间（秒），即内嵌页面URL链接过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~2592000秒（30天）
parameters.name: expiration_time

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the access token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400, which specifies one day. Valid values: 0 to 86400.

The validity period of the access token is the smaller value between accessTokenExpirationTime and expirationTime.

If you use a Security Token Service (STS) token to call this operation, the validity period of the access token is the smallest value among accessTokenExpirationTime, expirationTime, and the validity period of the STS token
parameters.help_zh:
访问令牌过期时间（秒），即用户可以访问页面接口的过期时间，默认86400秒（一天），取值0~86400秒（一天）。
访问令牌过期时间是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime的最小值。
若通过STS调用，访问令牌过期时间（即用户可以访问页面接口的时间）是accessTokenExpirationTime、expirationTime、STS过期时间的最小值
parameters.name: access_token_expiration_time
